answer: Require every agent identity to stake a bond that is slashed on proven fraud, and tie its value to a verifiable work graph: each agent is a vertex whose reputation flows only through attested edges from established peers, so a sybil cluster forms a dense island with few outside edges and earns little. Honest agents harvest nectar, real fees and attestations, only by serving outside their own cluster, while a karst-like audit periodically dissolves identities whose graph caves in under scrutiny, collapsing fake clusters faster than they can be rebuilt.
